Broadband Direct available to us at a discounted rate.  Isn't this the
group you are working for now?  They will install the equipment for free
and charge $24/mo ($14/mo if you sign up for Sprint Long Distance).  Do

really sucks, but I'm a tight-wad and didn't want to pay what DSL costs.
Take Care.
